resources.string: Say “Hey Tetra” to open AI Assist, even with the screen off. It compares what the mic hears with your five takes, on the phone; nothing is sent while it listens. With the phone locked, personal things (calls, messages, mail, calendar, notes, files, contacts) ask you to unlock it first. On one device only: two would both answer, so leave it off on the tablet. Paused in the car.
Say “Hey Tetra” five times as you normally do, in a quiet room, the phone at arm’s length.
Unlike the others: record it again
Not caught (%1$s, wakes under %2$s). Record the takes again.
